description: data/ui/fonts.json (UH-6, D5; UL-2/D6): the 7 SHIPPED font presets engine/render/fonts.py's _FONT_SPECS ships, plus any number of DESIGNER-DEFINED extra presets, as schema-checked committed data. Loaded once at boot (game/main.py) and passed to engine.render.fonts.configure_fonts, which rebinds the font cache's point size/bold pair per key; the unconfigured module defaults equal this file's stock content for the 7 (tools/tests/test_theme_data.py pins it). For the 7 PINNED presets, font size changes drawn glyphs only — their layout_h entries (engine/render/fonts.py) are never moved, so stored layout rects are unaffected and text can overflow its widget if enlarged (the Theme panel says so). All 7 keys stay required: the game names them by key, so a missing one would silently break a screen, and none of them may be renamed or removed. Extra keys are ADDITIVE (UL-2, D6): any key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ carries the same {size, bold} shape and gets its layout_h derived once at configure time; the editor's Theme panel is the only writer. A key that does NOT match that pattern is still rejected outright.

hud_phase.description: HUD phase-banner readout, bottom-left of the game screen.

lg.description: Large UI text size (bold) — headings, button labels, panel titles.

md.description: Default/medium UI text size — most labels, buttons and readouts.

sm.description: Smallest UI text size — dense labels, wrapped body text, footer notes.

xl.description: Extra-large UI text size (bold) — screen titles.

xxl.description: Largest UI text size (bold) — the main menu title / big banners.
